description:
Team Myles O’Donoghue are delighted to present Apt 15, Garryknock, Bracken Park Drive, Dublin 15 to the market.

This superb two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers bright and spacious accommodation throughout and is ideally positioned within the modern and highly sought-after Bracken Park Drive development. The property is situated on the ground floor and benefits from one designated car parking space.

The accommodation briefly comprises a spacious entrance hallway with tiled flooring, leading to a generous kitchen / living area. The living accommodation is exceptionally bright and spacious, with a number of windows allowing an abundance of natural sunlight into the room. The kitchen is fully fitted with a range of integrated units and benefits from a central island, providing an excellent space for both everyday living and entertaining. The entrance hallway also provides access to a separate utility room, which houses the washer / dryer.

There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms, both of which benefit from fitted wardrobes and good quality carpet flooring. The main bedroom further benefits from a private ensuite bathroom, which is fully tiled and comprises a WC, wash hand basin and walk-in shower. A separate family bathroom completes the accommodation and features a white suite incorporated bath, WC and wash hand basin, with the room also fully tiled.

Garryknock is situated within Bracken Park Drive which is a modern and sought-after residential development ideally positioned close to a wealth of local amenities, including shops, cafés, leisure facilities and recreational amenities. The property also benefits from excellent transport links, providing easy access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. With its spacious accommodation, ground floor position, designated parking space and highly desirable location, this property is sure to appeal to first-time buyers, owner-occupiers and investors alike.
